notes:
- Control the trailer without leaving the viewer: The official trailer now has in-app rewind and forward controls that jump five seconds, plus a play/pause toggle. The controls stay disabled until YouTube's IFrame Player API reports that the player is ready, and the play/pause icon follows the real playback state. Seeking is kept within the start and end of the video.
- The trailer picture stays visible: The embedded WebView keeps its video surface opaque and hardware-backed, and reveals it without alpha or scale compositing. This avoids the black-picture, audio-only failure that can happen when an extra compositing layer drops the video plane.
